text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, the computer is given training data, which includes input examples and the correct answers. The computer then builds a model based on this data. Once the model is trained, it can make predictions on new, unseen data. For example, a model trained on pictures of cats and dogs can predict whether a new picture shows a cat or a dog. The accuracy of the model is measured by how often these predictions are correct. The better the training data, the more accurate the model becomes.
